page.layout: Page title "INDEX" centred at top; two parallel columns of index entries, left column then right column; signature "Vuu" centred at foot. No page number printed.
page.notes: Left column, bottom: the entry "specularia 828" and the entry "spelta 370" are as printed. The "447" under "spontanea oblatio" and the "585" under "specula" and "771", "760", "292" are wrapped page numbers from the line above, kept with their entries. Entry "spontanea oblatio, spōtaneus": the Greek-derived word after the comma is printed as "spōtaneus", with a macron over o; transcribed as spontaneus. Left-column "specularia" is read as specularia [?] because of the scan. The left-column entry "spem abjicere" appears in the scan as "spem abjicere" and is copied. The entry "stacte" is a Greek loanword, its last letters are unclear. The number "35.38" after "statum" is uncertain (could be 35.36 or 35.38). The "specula" heading and "I N D E X" title are read as printed. Dot in the scan between "speculatio" and "447" is a stray mark, not printed text.
